title: lint: validate-knowledge-source refuses an absent known platform name under a stated closure too, and its tenant-write wording drops the stack and manifest remedy
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwPhGV4g9p1BGQaZbP

Filing gate: ① follow-up of PR #38038 (#38019; contract review 7226609684 nits N1, N2 and N6, folded into one card as the review asks) · Source: topic #37000
Grading: area:ai · Feature · p3 (suggested: a leniency and wording on one rung; no wrong accept on the whole-collection door) · reach: a packaged `knowledge_source` published under a stated package closure that names an absent `sys_` object; a tenant author at a write that names no package · evidence: read of PR #38038 at 80a26dfbc5 by the contract review (no live run).
Dedupe: `is:issue knowledge-source-object-unknown closure` → checked at filing; open: #38019 (the parent follow-up), #37307 (the base card) only.
Reader: area o1-C of seat repo:objectstack#1 claims it after triage's first touch.

## 维护者速读
- 问题：#38038 让发布时找不到的平台对象(如 `sys_` 开头)直接报错，但只覆盖"整个已发布集合"这条路径；按包发布(常见路径)时同样的情况仍只是跳过。另外，给租户作者的报错说"本应用未定义""在 manifest 的 dependencies 里声明"，而租户作者既没有应用也没有 manifest。
- 做什么：按包发布时对 `sys_` 名字同样报错；把租户写入时的报错改成租户能照做的说法；顺带修两处说明文字。
- 谁受益：写知识源的应用作者和租户管理员(报错更早、更准，能照着改)。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What
1. N1: under a stated closure an absent known platform name is still skipped. The closure keeps every system object unconditionally (runtime-gate.ts, limb 1), so for a `sys_` name the snapshot is as final there as under the whole collection. Make that absent name a `knowledge-source-object-unknown` error under a closure as well. State in the PR whether `cloud_` and `ai_` names (which limb 1 may not keep) belong to the same arm, with the reading that decides it.
2. N2: the rule header says the two platform arms apply "both on the CLI and under a closure"; under a closure only the first does. `os explain`'s text places the not-judged arm "on the command line" only, though it also holds under a closure. Correct both to what the code does after item 1.
3. N6: at a write that names no package, the refusal says "which this stack does not define" and the hint offers "declare that package in the manifest's `dependencies`". A tenant author has no stack and no manifest. Word that arm for its reader (install the package, or name an object the organization has).

## Acceptance
- Under a stated closure, a source naming an absent `sys_` object is refused with `knowledge-source-object-unknown`; a present one passes (control). Pinned, with an ablation.
- The `cloud_` / `ai_` reading is stated and pinned.
- The rule header and `os explain` text match the arms.
- The no-package write's refusal names neither a stack nor a manifest.

Blocked-by: #38019
